name: metamodel.addStatus
title: Add status to type
summary: Give a type a status, an existing one or a new one; only the metamodel files that have them change, line by line.
details: With `status`, the type gets an existing status it does not have; with `name` (and `key`, `invalid` if needed), a new status is added at the end of `statuses` in the first metamodel file by name that has the list, else at the end of the first file, where the list is created (SR-236 AK4), and the type gets it (SR-240 AK1). Without `key`, the key is made from the name: lower case, the German umlauts and sharp s as ae, oe, ue and ss, other letters with a diacritic as the letter without it (é as e), every run of other characters one hyphen (SR-236 AK6); it is fixed afterwards (D-043). The type gets the key at the end of its own list of statuses, in the file it is in; the list is created when the type has none, and a key the list names already is not written again. A type that has no list, neither its own nor one of an ancestor, has every status: it gets the list of every status it had and the new one (SR-240 AK1). `alsoTypes` names the other types that get a new status too. Every other line stays as it was, with its comment and line ending (SR-236 AK3); no element file changes and nothing in Git (D-036). The metamodel afterwards is checked as a read would check it: an error refuses the command, warnings are in `problems` (SR-236 AK1). Errors: input.invalid with details.reason status-or-name when the input gives both `status` and a field of a new status, or neither; input.invalid with details.reason unknown when no type has the key (details.type) or no status has the key `status` (details.status); input.invalid with details.reason has when the type has the status already (details.type, details.status); input.invalid with details.reason taken when another status has the name, in Unicode normal form NFC, or the given key (details.field, details.status); input.invalid with details.reason key-required when no key is given and the one made from the name is empty, does not start with a letter, is longer than 64 characters or is another status's key (details.key); input.invalid with details.reason widens when a type that extends the type and has a list of its own would have more statuses (details.types); input.invalid with details.reason metamodel-invalid and the errors in details.problems when the metamodel would have an error; workspace.read-only when the metamodel files do not give a valid metamodel or the metamodel repository is not on this machine; input.invalid with details.reason git-folder when the metamodel folder is .git or a repository of its own (D-036); file.read-only when the metamodel repository cannot be written (SR-018 AK2); file.faulty when the type, the list `statuses` of the file or a node on the way to them is an alias or has an anchor (details.repository, details.file, details.line); file.changed-on-disk when another process changed a file since it was read (SR-236 AK10). Nothing is written on these.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-236 AK5: a metamodel that cannot be read is never changed (SR-011 AK3).

type.description: Key of the type that gets the status.

status.description: Key of an existing status the type does not have. Left out: `name` describes a new status.

name.description: Display name of a new status; no other status may have it.

key.description: Fixed key of the new status (D-043). Left out: made from the name (SR-236 AK6).

invalid.description: The new status is marked invalid: elements with it do not count for coverage and indirect verification, but stay visible in chains (D-044).

type.title: Type
type.description: Key of the type that got the status.

status.title: Status
status.description: The definition of the status, as written.

created.title: New status
created.description: true when the status is new to the metamodel.

statuses.title: Statuses of the type
statuses.description: The statuses of the type afterwards, own and inherited, in the order of the metamodel's statuses.

alsoTypes.title: Other types with it
alsoTypes.description: The other types that have the status now and did not before, except types that extend the type: types without a list of statuses, their own or an ancestor's, which have every status (SR-240 AK1), and types whose list names the key of a new status already (an unknown status before, a metamodel warning).

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

versionsChanged.title: Versions changed
versionsChanged.description: Elements whose version is another under the new metamodel (SR-015 AK4): elements of a type whose counted properties change and that have a value for one of them, such as elements of a type that was unknown before; those of `versionsChangedElements`.

missingRequired.title: Missing required properties
missingRequired.description: Elements that now miss a value of a required property they did not miss before (SR-015 AK3); those of `missingRequiredElements`.

versionsChangedElements.title: Elements with another version
versionsChangedElements.description: The elements `versionsChanged` counts, in store order.

missingRequiredElements.title: Elements missing a required property
missingRequiredElements.description: The elements `missingRequired` counts, in store order.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: The warnings of the metamodel afterwards (SR-236 AK1).
